subject: general
question: Eight friends, A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides. B is sitting to the immediate right of H who is sitting immediately right of E. C and D are immediate neighbors of A. C and F are immediate neighbors of G. E is immediate neighbour of F and H. If C, D, F and H are sitting at the corners of the table not necessarily in the same order, who is sitting to the immediate left of E?
solution:
**Given:** Eight friends, A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides. 

1) B is sitting to the immediate right of H who is sitting immediately right of E. 

2) E is immediate neighbour of F and H.

3) C, D, F and H are sitting at the corners of the table.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7bb5cc542b6493e7c0c24baa1c2247aeb8348d371097968e5eced8ddf8942eeb.png] 

4) C and F are immediate neighbors of G.

5) C and D are immediate neighbors of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93e56dd3a4e906261cbde2e03be2d77544b3ffcea2c49473214f475a9144cd68.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement F is sitting to the immediate left of E.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
